description: Use this first when the person wants to track, log or keep a record of something that keeps happening (bank transactions, Amazon orders, Shopify orders, Stripe payments, steps). Lists the ready-made tracks TrackerHacker sets up in one step: each is one kind of sheet with fixed columns (sheet.columns) and one kind of row (row: "one row per …"), and its questions only pick the source, so a bank, PayPal and Venmo fill the same sheet. Use one only when its row is the same thing the person wants a row for and its columns hold it; otherwise find_templates or create_custom_track.
name: list_ready_made
title: List ready-made tracks
